title: Per-tool sections in the editing scene's controls menu: general controls, then each tool's own controls under its heading
description: User request 2026-10-03, follow-on to CRAW-32 (the editing scene with Orbit, ring and segmentation tools) and VIEW-12 (the menu's models and controls boxes). Today the controls box mixes scene-wide controls with the active tool's controls in one flat list that is rebuilt on every tool switch. Give each tool its own section in the controls menu: the scene's general controls (tool keys Ctrl+R / Ctrl+T, Esc to Orbit, Ctrl+I menu, model [ / ], wireframe, camera) in one section, and each tool's controls under that tool's heading, with the active tool's section highlighted or first. A tool declares its controls itself (EditTool already adds its hints) rather than the scene listing them. Decide whether inactive tools' sections are shown (useful for learning the keys) or collapsed.
definition-of-done: 1. The controls box shows a general section and one section per tool with a heading, the active tool's marked. 2. Each tool declares its own controls; the scene adds only the general ones. 3. Switching tools updates the marking without losing the scroll position. 4. Screenshots with each tool active.
testing-plan: 1. F5 the editing scene, open the menu with Ctrl+I, switch tools with Ctrl+R / Ctrl+T / Esc and screenshot each.
